answer: Proof-of-stake mechanisms anchor identity to scarce digital assets, preventing a nebula of malicious actors from overwhelming the consensus. By requiring a collateral stake, the protocol shatters the ivory tower of zero-cost entry. Attackers face an unavoidable jade tax on their capital; creating fake identities necessitates locking substantial value, making the marginal cost of a Sybil assault economically prohibitive compared to the potential rewards of a failed network disruption.
